title:
A simple representation of a key pair (a {@link CryptoPublicKey publicKey} and a {@link CryptoPrivateKey privateKey}).
To use this type, your {@link CryptoPrivateKey privateKey} and {@link CryptoPublicKey publicKey} (or
{@link X509Certificate X509Certificate}) should be configured in {@link Config config} and both have the same id.
name: CryptoKeyPair
